text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cafeeeeee～ Have you been doing anything fun
lately?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hol' up,
hol' up.
At least give me a more serious answer. 
Like "Why are you asking me that?".
Try to take an interest here.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …… No.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let me explain why I'm here! So,
you see, 
the student council is currently making a
new school pamphlet 
and they need help gathering materials.
Have you heard about it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see this as an opportunity.
This is a chance to get a favor fro- 
I mean.
I see this as a chance to uphold the school's
values.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That being said,
let's go search for some items we can
submit 
for the pamphlet.
Anything interesting that comes to mind?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Do it by yourself. I wish you the best,
but 
I'm already busy doing something else.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait.
That's not fair! I shared my own personal 
circumstances.
It's only right for you to respond in kind,
right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What? You're going to see Pokke?
By yourself? 
Well, this is unlike you, Café.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Pokke has been hanging with some horsegirls
from outside 
the school.
It seems that something weird might be going
on.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
To be honest,
I'm not necessarily interested in the
specifics 
of what's going on.
But the place that it is happening at…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So, you are interested? No,
the way you're saying it implies 
that you know something will happen.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
To tell the whole truth,
that place isn't the place you should be 
around. That's all I wanted to tell Pokke.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: … That's it… You satisfied now?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kuku —
Yes, I'm satisfied, and satisfied, and 
satisfactorily satisfied,
Café! Thanks for the tip!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …… What?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now come, let us go to Pokke together!! 
This would all make great material!!

text_block_list.name: Uncouth Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: The hell do you want?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We're looking for Pokke.
Is she not here yet?

text_block_list.name: Uncouth Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
You two are friends with Pocket? Pocket 
is busy right now. You can talk with me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No, we would like to talk directly with her,
please.

text_block_list.name: Uncouth Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Did you listen to anything I just said,
huh?! 
I said,
Pocket doesn't have the time for punks like
you!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Don't go around putting words in my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Uncouth Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
P-Pocket!? 
Pocket…!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up and get lost.
These two are my guests.

text_block_list.name: Uncouth Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: Utmost apologies!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wassup, Tachyon,
Café!? Sorry about that. Those guys 
were kind of going off doing their own
thing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So that was it.
They were the cause of the horsegirls 
not from the school stirring up trouble.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The hell?
So even you two have heard that? 
Let me tell you what actually happened.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Some of my underclassmen friends got together
here to 
participate in an unofficial race.
Unfortunately, they lost.

text_block_list.name: Uncouth Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
They were doing something to cheat!
But they're still out here 
saying stuff like "Tracen Academy is washed
up" to provoke us.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I know you're frustrated. Don't worry,
I will 
definitely beat some sense into them.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: … You were planning on starting a fight?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Nothing as lame as that.
I was planning on settling it 
on the course with some hard hitting
payback.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho?! So,
you were planning on taking on the other
horsegirls 
in another unofficial race! Kuku,
now this is interesting!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, do you mind if I accompany you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec, by "I" you mean "us" right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? This is my problem.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what are you saying!?
Your underclassmen 
are just as precious to us as they are to
you. Indeed!
They are all our beloved underclassmen!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As fellow students at the same school.
As their upperclassmen! 
It is our duty to uphold their name!
Isn't that right!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You can just ignore everything that comes 
out of her mouth.
I just want to make sure 
that this place can become peaceful again.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh! Sure,
why not. Just don't hold me back.
